directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Thank you so much, man! If it wasn't for you, those thugs would have shot me...
entries.JA_current: Thank you so much, man! If it wasn't for you, those thugs would have shot me...
entries.JA_new: 本当にありがとう！ あんたが来てくれなかったら、あのチンピラに撃たれてたよ……

entries.EN: I'm glad I got here in time. Are you okay?
entries.JA_current: I'm glad I got here in time. Are you okay?
entries.JA_new: 間に合ってよかった。大丈夫か？

entries.EN: I'm.. I'm fine, think I took one to the vest but.. it will heal before the wedding, as they say. How can I thank you?
entries.JA_current: I'm.. I'm fine, think I took one to the vest but.. it will heal before the wedding, as they say. How can I thank you?
entries.JA_new: だ、大丈夫だ。ベストに一発食らった気がするが……そのうち治るさ。結婚式までには治る、ってな。どう礼を言えばいい？

entries.EN: I don't want anything from you, except some information. To begin with, I know who you really are, but that's not the point. All I want to know is this: where is the group now?
entries.JA_current: I don't want anything from you, except some information. To begin with, I know who you really are, but that's not the point. All I want to know is this: where is the group now?
entries.JA_new: 礼はいらない。情報を教えてくれればいい。まず、あんたの正体は知ってる。だが今はそこじゃない。知りたいのは、あの一団が今どこにいるかだ。

entries.EN: Ah, so it IS you... It turns out that Waterman's plans will be ruined after all.
entries.JA_current: Ah, so it IS you... It turns out that Waterman's plans will be ruined after all.
entries.JA_new: ああ、やっぱりあんたか……どうやらウォーターマンの計画は潰れるらしいな。

entries.EN: What are you talking about? Be more specific. Who's Waterman? The leader?
entries.JA_current: What are you talking about? Be more specific. Who's Waterman? The leader?
entries.JA_new: 何の話だ？ もっと具体的に言ってくれ。ウォーターマンって誰だ？ リーダーか？
そうだ。あいつが指揮を執ってる。

entries.EN: Let's start at the beginning. Why do they call you an agent? Tell me everything in order.
entries.JA_current: Let's start at the beginning. Why do they call you an agent? Tell me everything in order.
entries.JA_new: 最初から話してくれ。なぜあんたをエージェントと呼ぶ？ 知ってることを順に全部話せ。

entries.EN: With pleasure! What.. Are you surprised that I'm willing to tell you everything so easily? The thing is, I'm not really with Waterman and his group, I was just hired by them to run errands, carry messages and gather info, stuff like that. I didn't know who they were at the beginning, all I knew was that they paid well. Really well! I thought they were just some merc outfit, they're the only ones with money around here. But then, things started to get weird with some of the instructions I was given, it was all very fishy.. So, I decided to take a peek inside one of their stashes, hooked up a USB to my PDA.. Yeah, bad idea, I know.. Must've been protected somehow, because as I started reading the shit on it, my PDA send some type of data packet across the network and died all of a sudden, like from a virus or something! One thing was for sure, they'd definitely know what I had done and there was no going back. I was certain they'd ice me after what I'd seen on there, and boy was I right. How much you wanna bet that Waterman paid for these mercs? Anyway, let's get to the point.. Did you know the information on that USB was about you??

entries.JA_new: 喜んで話すよ！ こんなに簡単に話すのが意外か？ 実は、俺はウォーターマンたちの仲間じゃない。使い走りをしたり、伝言を運んだり、情報を集めたりする仕事を雇われてやってただけだ。最初は相手が誰なのか知らなかった。ただ、報酬がよかったんだ。本当にな！ 金を持ってるのはマーセナリーズくらいだから、傭兵の一団だと思ってた。でも、妙な指示が増えてきた。どうにもきな臭くてな……それで、隠し場所の一つをのぞいて、USBメモリをPDAにつないだ。ああ、やるんじゃなかった……何かで保護されてたんだろう。中身を読み始めた途端、PDAがネットワークに何かのデータパケットを送って、ウイルスにやられたみたいに突然壊れた！ 一つだけ確かなのは、連中に何をしたか知られたってことだ。もう後戻りできなかった。見た物のせいで殺されると思ったよ。実際、その通りだった。あのマーセナリーズを雇ったのも、ウォーターマンじゃないか？ とにかく本題に戻ろう……USBの情報がお前についてのものだったって、知ってたか？
話してくれ。ちゃんと聞いてる。

entries.EN: Well, you're not gonna believe this, but- ...
entries.JA_current: Well, you're not gonna believe this, but- ...
entries.JA_new: 実は、信じられないかもしれないが――……
